A direct hyperspace corridor between System Alpha and System Beta is absent.
Furthermore, due to a navigational anomaly, exactly one of the following two routes must be incorporated into the itinerary: the corridor between System Beta and System Gamma, or the corridor between System Gamma and System Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop trajectory that visits every system precisely once and returns to the point of origin, minimizing the total travel distance.
